environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards requests to the Flask app on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to EC2 on 8080. No additional request inspection or filtering is configured on the ALB. The application database is a local SQLite file. API keys are distributed to internal service accounts and partner integrations.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules, no WAF attached
config.network: VPC with public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound
config.auth: API keys distributed to 12 service accounts and 3 partner orgs
